environment: Actual .NET browser-wasm in Node Worker through public compiler/project APIs

tests.name: Compile genuine MSBuild task using public Worker compiler
Project UsingTask generates files and returns metadata/typed outputs through WASM
Project resources and task-generated code execute from the actual emitted assembly
Second project build reuses task outputs and emits executable assembly again
Changing input invalidates the managed target content cache
Managed task errors and OnError cleanup propagate through public project build
Culture RESX produces genuine satellite assemblies and ResourceManager resolves cultures
Nested MSBuild projects and metadata batches generate real C# compiled and executed in WASM
Exec runs a real native WASI command and compiles its generated C# in managed WASM
